correctness.rationale: The full-run criterion follows by an inner inverse giving an idempotent with a path image, and conversely a dihedral inner inverse. Marked full runs count exactly 2n^2 sum W. Distinct full runs share no edges, so their unordered pair count is at most 2n^3 sum rho_h^(n-2h). The endpoint path spectrum yields the lower matching confinement exponent K; uniform spectral inequalities give the pair exponent 2^(2/3)K. Thus regular maps equal 2n times idempotents up to the stated stretched-exponential relative error. The standalone checker independently enumerates balanced step words for n=4,...,18 and verifies exact finite identities and inequalities. Direct semigroup-composition tests on all endomorphisms for n=4,6,8 verify f*g*f=f independently of the marked-run criterion.

value.rationale: Von Neumann regularity and idempotent retractions are intrinsically motivated semigroup properties. An asymptotically exact factor 2n, accompanied by a sharp exponential uniqueness bound for the full monotone witness, refines prior idempotent totals and gives a structural explanation for regular nonidempotents. This is neither a mere known total count nor an arbitrary finite computation.
